articles.summary: The response to MIT’s study showing ‘95% of Enterprise AI projects are failing’ has been one of gleeful schadenfreud for people like me who love soapboxing about how most technology headlines are fake, fraud, or grossly exaggerated.
articles.title: MIT Study Reveals That Custom IT Projects Are Hard
